title: Deliberative quality, AI steering, inclusion, and decision traceability

claim_ceiling.synthetic_conformance: Establishes behavior only for exact declared fixtures, model assumptions, and evaluator bounds.
claim_ceiling.human_experiment: Supports causal claims only for the preregistered population, randomization, treatment, outcomes, and analysis assumptions.
claim_ceiling.platform_comparison: Describes matched workflows and observed capability differences; does not establish universal product superiority.
claim_ceiling.institutional_impact: Requires separate outcome evidence and independent evaluation; deliberation quality alone does not prove policy benefit or legitimacy.

intervention_conditions.description: Unassisted group deliberation; no AI-generated contribution or analysis shown to participants.
Trained human facilitation under a versioned facilitation protocol.
The selected platform's native workflow without additional AI intervention.
Optional non-directive AI-guided reflection before group discussion; no group-facing recommendations.
AI summary or argument map generated after the discussion; not visible to participants during deliberation.
AI participation or facilitation during discussion; treated as a distinct, higher-steering-risk condition.
Optional AI-generated counterarguments or evidence questions; participant-controlled and separately randomized where appropriate.

metric_families.primary_method: Human-coded transcript or interaction record using a frozen coding manual; DQI may be used with versioned operationalization.

metric_families.caveat: Equal word counts, turns, airtime, or satisfaction do not alone establish equitable influence.

metric_families.gate: Rights, privacy, and authority violations are non-compensatory failures.

reference_workflows.comparison_layer: Participatory process lifecycle, proposals, assemblies, debate, voting, and accountability.
Asynchronous organizational discussions, proposals, polls, and decision records.
Open-ended contributions, agree/disagree responses, opinion grouping, and cross-group statements.
Structured synchronous small-group discussion, managed speaking turns, agendas, moderation, and participation analytics.

annotation_policy.coding_manual: Versioned and frozen before confirmatory annotation
annotation_policy.blinding: Blind annotators to intervention condition where feasible
annotation_policy.disagreement: Retain and report annotator disagreement; do not hide it with majority labels
annotation_policy.llm_annotations: Secondary method only; separately compare with held-out human judgments and report subgroup error
annotation_policy.reliability: Report suitable inter-rater reliability statistics and uncertainty; do not impose a universal threshold before feasibility study.

initial_targets.independent_double_coded_feasibility_cor: Required before scaled human annotation; sample size to be justified in protocol.
initial_targets.confirmatory_human_study: Only after ethics review and preregistration.
